runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification; touching timestamps is not verification. Existing records remain active when a new sweep does not rediscover them; absence from search is not deactivation evidence.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 06:11 sweep actually searched 11 source families: Profesia, direct-company careers, LinkedIn Jobs public index, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera/Zoznam, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and Facebook public indexing. No new promotion-grade unique hit cleared location, language, qualification, economics and trust gates. LinkedIn reverified Wolt Support Associate full/part time in Bratislava, but both require English B2 and shift/weekend coverage. Worki exposed fresh Devinska Nova Ves warehouse-driver inventory, but physical/logistics scope remains low-priority. Kariera produced fresh BA driver/taxi inventory, but results were low-pay, multilingual, night-shift or long-haul/C+E mismatches. Praca za rohom surfaced TELOMAR e-shop customer support at 170-250 CZK/h with home-office component, but canonical detail requires roughly two weeks of combined onboarding partly in Jinočany near Prague and ongoing office/home combination, so it fails remote-ok and is reject-distance. Upwork returned Worldwide WordPress/e-commerce/VA candidates, but current results were low-budget, stale, English-heavy, overlong-hours or development-heavy. Reddit returned one hiring post restricted to US residents and multiple freelancer-supply posts. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable hiring posts.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Remote onboarding geography verifier
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Before assigning remote-ok, extract any mandatory onsite onboarding or training location, duration and recurrence. A role advertised as home office can still be operationally incompatible when onboarding requires days or weeks in a distant city, as in the Jinočany e-shop support listing.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Student-status hard-gate extractor
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Detect when a part-time or brigade vacancy is explicitly limited to current students rather than merely student-friendly. Store the distinction as an eligibility field so otherwise attractive support/admin roles do not repeatedly consume verification time.
